claims.claim: It is an open wardrobe, can be used at home or boutique.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a wooden wardrobe/cabinet with multiple open compartments/shelves and items inside; no fully closed door is visible.
Witness report does not show purchase date, receipt, or any identifying label/model.
Witness report mentions dust/wear and clutter inside, but does not confirm absence of stains/tears.
Witness report describes a wardrobe/cabinet; no foam is shown or referenced in the observations.
Witness report does not include smell/odor testing or evidence of smoke exposure.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete doors/frames/parts (stability and security issues).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing all door panels/hinges/handles/rails/knobs fully present and closed (front view + side view), plus a quick open/close test clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a wardrobe cabinet with missing/incomplete door hardware and reduced security/function.

risks.risk: Structural weakness: wobble, damaged frame/sides, or loose shelves.
risks.proof: A short clip where the buyer gently pushes/pulls the cabinet to show wobble (top, middle, bottom) and close-up photos of joints and shelf supports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially unstable/with possible frame or shelf damage.

risks.risk: Hidden damage not visible in the interior (cracks, water damage, pests, stains).
risks.proof: Photos of the underside/back corners and all shelf edges, plus a close-up inspection of any seams; include a flashlight scan for stains/water marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown internal condition (assume worst-case: possible stains/wear).

risks.risk: Material quality (wood vs particle board) and shelf load capacity.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of thickness/edge material and any manufacturer label; show shelf underside/support construction.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lower-quality board construction with limited load capacity.

risks.risk: Cleanliness/odor (smoke smell, musty smell) affecting usability.
risks.proof: A smell/odor check clip (seller opens and shows interior; buyer confirms no odor) and a photo of cleaned surfaces (wiped shelves).
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing cleaning and possible odor risk.

proof_requests: Send full front view with all doors/frames shown closed (if any exist) and a side view showing the full depth.
Provide a short open/close test clip for every door/hinge/handle and show any locks/knobs.
Show a stability test clip (gentle push/pull at top and middle) and close-ups of joints and shelf supports.
Send underside/back-corner photos and close-ups of shelf edges/seams for cracks, water marks, or pest signs.
Show any labels/brand/model and, if available, a receipt or proof of purchase date.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an open wooden wardrobe/cabinet and reports visible wear/dust and incomplete/uncertain door closure, so a worst-case price can be set without relying on the seller’s unverified claims.
